description: This file defines classes and templates for handling asynchronous completion callbacks, primarily used for testing asynchronous operations in the Chromium project. It includes callback wrappers, internal base classes, and utility classes for managing callback results and synchronization.

classes.name: TestCompletionCallback
classes.description: A class for testing completion callbacks that stores the result and provides a callback function.

classes.name: TestInt64CompletionCallback
classes.description: A specialized callback class for 64-bit integer results, used in testing.

classes.name: ReleaseBufferCompletionCallback
classes.description: A callback class that ensures an IOBuffer is not referenced after the callback runs.

classes.name: internal::TestCompletionCallbackBaseInternal
classes.description: Base internal class managing the wait loop and result state for callbacks.

classes.name: internal::TestCompletionCallbackTemplate
classes.description: Template class for handling callback results, with support for pending/error checking.

methods.name: WaitForResult
methods.description: Waits for the asynchronous operation to complete and returns the result.

methods.name: callback
methods.description: Returns a callback bound to the internal SetResult method.

methods.name: SetResult
methods.description: Sets the callback result and signals completion.
